checker.description:
Nucleus is an independently implemented Rust proof checker developed by
[Metalogic Labs](https://mathgraph.org/). It is separate from MathGraph Flash,
the sokonanoda-derived checker on the main Arena.

This initial preview entry supports a bounded fragment of export format
3.2.0. It reconstructs admitted nonrecursive inductive families and
recursors from source types, validates their feature flags and computation
rules, and checks a bounded projection fragment with dependent field
substitutions. Unsupported declarations or conversions are declined.
The launcher freezes the qualified configuration and explicitly declines
inputs larger than 10 MiB. It passes input bytes unchanged and consults no
external checker at runtime. Full Mathlib acceptance is not established.
checker.name: nucleus

boundary: Current beta published metadata and Nucleus result records, distinct from Flash in the stable Arena. Published source/body claims do not substitute for individual result rows. No complete Mathlib performance warrant.
